title: myroxylon elegans
intro: Myroxylon elegans, commonly known as Palo Santo, is a tropical plant species native to South America. The health benefits of Palo Santo include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Palo Santo include its ability to reduce anxiety and improve mood, as well as its potential to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Palo Santo include limonene, beta-pinene, and myrcene, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
